newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Honko Int'l issues 40 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Honko Int'l issues 40 mln new shares.

text.p: Honko International Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it would issue a total of 40 million new shares to three companies controlled by its chairman Lam Yat Keung, raising net proceeds of HK$41 million.

Honko said the three companies had agreed to place a total of 40 million shares through a placing agent to third party investors at HK$1.06 each before they subscribed the same amount of new shares at a net placing price after expenses.
The three companies are Joytek Holdings Ltd, Universal Legend Ltd and Maxtop Holdings Ltd.
On completion of the deal, Lam's shareholding in Honko International will be reduced to 56.51 percent from 64.94 percent, the company said.
The net proceeds will be used to repay bank loans and for general working capital, it said.
Honko shares resumed trading on Thursday after a one-day suspension and were down HK$0.12 to HK$1.14 just before the midday break.
